hostedpypi

Install

pipuvpoetry
pip install --index-url "https://token:$SINDRI_TOKEN@sindri.example.test/pypi/internal-py/simple/" demo

The token travels as the password of the index URL, so $SINDRI_TOKEN must be set in your shell.
